episodes.title: The Wayfarer
episodes.summary: After three years crossing seas, deserts and the Silk Road, a young Marco Polo finds himself a prisoner of the great Kublai Khan.

episodes.title: The Wolf and the Deer
episodes.summary: As Kublai Khan battles his warmonger brother for rule over Mongolia, Marco learns that justice in Khan's Imperial City is as swift as it is deadly.

episodes.title: Feast
episodes.summary: Marco begins a dangerous relationship with the beautiful Blue Princess as tensions grow between Kublai and Xiangyang's cunning chancellor Jia Sidao.

episodes.title: The Fourth Step
episodes.summary: As war looms with the walled city of Xiangyang, Prince Jingim tests his diplomacy skills while Kublai questions Marco's allegiance.

episodes.title: Hashshashin
episodes.summary: Marco searches for the mastermind behind a murderous plot, while Prince Jingim weighs the risks of retaliation.

episodes.title: White Moon
episodes.summary: On the eve of an auspicious ceremony, Marco searches for the culprit behind the assassination attempt on Kublai Khan - even as a new one takes shape.

episodes.title: The Scholar's Pen
episodes.summary: Marco and Hundred Eyes take on a dangerous mission to infiltrate the walled city of Xiangyang, while its chancellor struggles to hold on to power.

episodes.title: Rendering
episodes.summary: When Kublai sets his sights - and his army - on the taking of the walled city of Xiangyang, Marco's allegiance is tested.

episodes.title: Prisoners
episodes.summary: Marco finds his fate in the hands of Kublai yet again, while behind the walls of Xiangyang, Chancellor Sidao sets his sights on regaining power.

episodes.title: The Heavenly and Primal
episodes.summary: Marco's ingenuity - and loyalty - is put to the ultimate test when Kublai takes a violent and bold step in his quest to become emperor of the world.

episodes.title: Hunter and the Sable Weaver
episodes.summary: On Prince Jingim's wedding day, Kublai receives disturbing news about the ambitions of his cousin, while Marco navigates a delicate mission.

episodes.title: Hug
episodes.summary: Marco gets an unpleasant surprise upon his return to Kublai's court. Kublai faces an impossibly difficult decision.

episodes.title: Measure Against the Linchpin
episodes.summary: Haunted by recent events, Kublai journeys with Marco into the mountains for answers. Empress Chabi takes action to insure an heir to the Khan.

episodes.title: Let God's Work Begin
episodes.summary: The challenge for the throne escalates when two of Kublai's sons are endangered. Far away, another threat to the khan is born.

episodes.title: Lullaby
episodes.summary: Rebel attacks flare up in the south and pull Kublai's attention away from home. Kokachin gets an unwelcome visitor from her past. And a glimpse of Ahmad's origin is shown.

episodes.title: Serpent's Terms
episodes.summary: Ahmed's deadly and secret chess match against Kublai enters its endgame, even as Kublai's thirst for power grows stronger than ever.

episodes.title: Lost Crane
episodes.summary: Kaidu's ruthlessness reaches new levels in his bid for power, while Hundred Eyes' former lover has him questioning his loyalties.

episodes.title: Whitehorse
episodes.summary: Marco's allegiance to Kublai is tested like never before. Mei Lin's bold move throws Ahmed's plans into chaos.

episodes.title: Heirs
episodes.summary: Marco's past with Kokachin resurfaces. Kublai's position as khan faces a final challenge, even as he welcomes a new heir in the world.

episodes.title: The Fellowship
episodes.summary: The day of the kurultai arrives, shaping Kublai's fate as khan. Ahmed makes his final stand, and Marco learns a terrible truth.
